home.heroTitle: Walk KwaZulu-Natal with the people who live here
home.heroText: Village walks, Big 5 game drives, wetland tours and door-to-door shuttles — planned and guided by a local team from Hluhluwe.
home.introTitle: Small groups, local guides, real places
home.introText: Khondlo Tours started in Hluhluwe in 2016. We take guests into the homesteads, schools and farms of our own community, into the game reserves we grew up next to, and we drive you there and back safely.
home.introPoint1: Guides from the area who know its history and its people
home.introPoint2: Licensed drivers and well-kept minibuses, sedans and SUVs
home.introPoint3: Part of every village tour goes back to the community
home.toursText: Half-day, full-day and multi-day trips from Hluhluwe and St Lucia.
home.shuttleTitle: Getting here is part of the trip
home.shuttleText: We collect you at the airport, the cruise terminal or your hotel and bring you to Zululand — on time, with room for your luggage.
home.mozTitle: Four days to Ponta do Ouro, Mozambique
home.mozText: Beach, village markets, quad biking and ziplining — we handle the border crossing at Kosi Bay.
home.communityTitle: Your visit stays in the village
home.communityText: We employ and train local guides and drivers, buy from local crafters and farmers, and arrange school visits where guests meet learners and teachers. Tourism here should leave something behind.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us where you want to go
home.ctaText: Send your dates and group size, and we reply with a clear quote.

tours.pageText: Every tour includes a local guide and transport from your accommodation in Hluhluwe or St Lucia. Pick-ups further away are quoted separately.

macabuzela.name: Macabuzela Village Walking Tour
macabuzela.short: Walk the footpaths of Macabuzela with a local guide, visit family homesteads and hear stories passed down through generations.
macabuzela.intro: This is the tour we are proudest of. You walk between homesteads on red-earth footpaths with views over the hills, meet the families who live there and learn how daily life, food and custom work in a Zulu village today.
macabuzela.h1: Hear first-hand stories from elders and families
macabuzela.h2: Step inside a traditional homestead and rondavel
macabuzela.h3: Walk footpaths with wide views over the hills
macabuzela.h4: Stop at a local school or pineapple farm when arranged in advance
macabuzela.h5: Your fee supports the families and projects you visit
macabuzela.know: Wear closed shoes and a hat. The walk is slow and suitable for most fitness levels. Ask before photographing people — most are happy to say yes.

hluhluwe.name: Hluhluwe-iMfolozi Game Drive
hluhluwe.short: Look for the Big 5 in Africa’s oldest proclaimed game reserve, once the royal hunting ground of King Shaka.
hluhluwe.intro: Hluhluwe-iMfolozi is the only state-run park in KwaZulu-Natal with all of the Big 5, and famous for its white and black rhino. Your guide reads the tracks and knows the waterholes.
hluhluwe.h1: Search for lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino
hluhluwe.h2: Drive through hills and river valleys of the reserve
hluhluwe.h3: Learn how the park saved the white rhino
hluhluwe.h4: Gate fees and a meal are included
hluhluwe.know: Full-day tours leave early in the morning, when animals are most active. Bring binoculars, a warm layer and sunscreen.
hluhluwe.option1: Full day, with gate fees and lunch
hluhluwe.option2: Half day, with gate fees and breakfast or lunch

isimangaliso.name: iSimangaliso Wetland Park
isimangaliso.short: Beaches, lakes and coastal forest in a World Heritage Site — with snorkelling, bird watching or a sunset drive.
isimangaliso.intro: iSimangaliso is one of Africa’s great wetland and coastal parks. Choose a full or half day with snorkelling, a slow sunset drive, or join us for snorkelling or birding on their own.
isimangaliso.h1: Snorkel in the clear water along the coast
isimangaliso.h2: Look for hippo, crocodile and hundreds of bird species
isimangaliso.h3: Watch the sun set over the estuary with snacks and red wine
isimangaliso.h4: Gate fees included on all park tours
isimangaliso.know: Snorkelling depends on tide and sea conditions — we plan the day around them. Bring a swimsuit and towel.
isimangaliso.option1: Full day, with gate fees, breakfast, lunch and snorkelling
isimangaliso.option2: Half day, with gate fees, breakfast and snorkelling
isimangaliso.option3: Sunset drive, 3 hours, with gate fees, snacks and red wine

elephant.name: Elephant Interaction
elephant.short: An educational touch-and-feed encounter with Rambo and Rachel, two elephants cared for by their handlers.
elephant.intro: Meet Rambo and Rachel up close. Their handlers explain how elephants live, eat and communicate, and you help feed them under supervision.
elephant.h1: Meet two elephants with their handlers
elephant.h2: Learn about elephant behaviour and conservation
elephant.h3: Lunch of your choice and return transfer included
elephant.know: Children are welcome with an adult. Follow the handlers’ instructions at all times.
elephant.option1: Interaction, gate fees, lunch and transfer

hippo.name: St Lucia Hippo Boat Cruise
hippo.short: Two hours on the St Lucia estuary, close to hippo pods, crocodiles and water birds.
hippo.intro: The St Lucia estuary has one of the largest hippo populations in South Africa. The boat moves slowly along the banks so you can watch and photograph them safely.
hippo.h1: See hippo pods and Nile crocodiles from the water
hippo.h2: Spot fish eagles, kingfishers and herons
hippo.h3: Easy to combine with an iSimangaliso tour
hippo.know: Morning and late-afternoon cruises have the best light. Boat times depend on the operator’s schedule.

mozambique.name: 4-Day Mozambique Trip to Ponta do Ouro
mozambique.short: Beach days, village markets, quad biking and ziplining in southern Mozambique, with transport and the border crossing handled.
mozambique.intro: We drive you from Hluhluwe across the Kosi Bay border to Ponta do Ouro. You stay three nights at Otia Hotel with breakfast and dinner, and spend your days between the beach, the village and the dunes.
mozambique.d1: Early departure, about 5 hours including the Kosi Bay border crossing. Check in at Otia Hotel, then the beach or a local market. Dinner at the hotel.
mozambique.d2: Guided tour of Ponta do Ouro village and its craft markets. Free afternoon at the beach, with optional snorkelling. Breakfast and dinner.
mozambique.d3: Morning quad biking on coastal trails and dunes, afternoon ziplining. Free time for the cafés. Breakfast and dinner.
mozambique.d4: Breakfast, a last beach walk or souvenir shopping, then the drive home. Back in Hluhluwe by late afternoon.
mozambique.inc2: 3 nights at Otia Hotel, shared room
mozambique.inc3: Breakfast and dinner daily (dinner up to R200 per person)
mozambique.inc5: Guided tour of Ponta do Ouro
mozambique.exc4: Visa fees, if your passport needs one
mozambique.know: You need a passport valid for at least 6 months. The price is an estimate and can change with season, exchange rates and availability.

shuttles.pageText: Door-to-door transfers between Zululand, the major airports and the Richards Bay cruise terminal. Send us your flight or ship details and we plan the pick-up around them.
shuttles.kingShakaText: Durban’s international airport. About 2.5 hours to Hluhluwe or St Lucia.
shuttles.orTamboText: A full-day drive of about 7 hours, with comfort stops on the way.
shuttles.richardsBayText: The closest airport to Hluhluwe, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
shuttles.airstripsText: We meet charter flights and link lodges, hotels and game reserves.
shuttles.cruiseText: A dedicated shuttle between the Richards Bay harbour cruise terminal and Hluhluwe, St Lucia and the game reserves — timed to your ship’s arrival and departure. Private cars or group minibuses.
shuttles.fleetText: Minibuses from 10 to 22 seats for groups and tours, sedans and SUVs for private and business transfers, and luxury vehicles for VIP guests. All with licensed drivers and GPS tracking.
shuttles.how1: Send your flight or ship details, pick-up address and number of passengers.
shuttles.how2: We confirm the vehicle and a fixed price in writing.
shuttles.how3: Your driver meets you with a Khondlo Tours name board.

about.pageTitle: A tourism and transport company from Hluhluwe
about.pageText: Khondlo Tours (Pty) Ltd is based in the Engonyamaneni area of Hluhluwe. We started in 2016 to give visitors safe, reliable and honest travel in KwaZulu-Natal — and to make sure the communities they visit benefit.
about.vision: To be the most trusted tour and shuttle company in KwaZulu-Natal.
about.mission: To connect people with the beauty, culture and spirit of KwaZulu-Natal through safe, comfortable and memorable journeys.
about.communityText: We employ and train local guides and drivers, support local artisans and cultural projects, partner with community tourism initiatives and keep our trips low-impact.
about.whoText: Holiday visitors from South Africa and abroad, tour groups and cruise passengers, businesses, schools and universities, event organisers, government departments and NGOs.
about.expoTitle: You may have met us at an expo
about.expoText: We take part in tourism shows across South Africa to meet travel agents, hotels and new guests.
